rationale: Validate and document the existing NEWAPP status console and rolling control-plane behavior. The protected launcher/controller already exists; the executor should add only allowed-path tests/docs/evidence proving it reports Git, queue, validation and blockers correctly.
validation_focus: Do not edit start_agent.bat, .ai/controller/**, .ai/agent_config.yaml or other protected control-plane paths.
Add focused tests or safe diagnostics under tests/** and documentation under docs/** for status/preflight/rolling queue behavior.
Verify preflight is read-only and status data is machine-readable without secret values.
Verify pending GPT review does not globally block an unrelated dependency-safe task.
risks: Do not weaken Human Gates or dependency rules.
Do not expose .env values in status output or evidence.
If an acceptance point requires a protected-path change, report it instead of editing the protected path.
